title: RWANG Node Manifest
description: Normative schema for a per-node manifest (CR-2026-08-20-01 A2 §2.3.5), e.g. docs/domains/DOM-01--playback/manifest.yaml. The manifest's SCHEMA is Core-owned (part of the Hybrid IR); its filename/location convention is adapter-owned. A manifest declares OUTGOING edge assertions only — one edge has exactly one from-side assertion source (RWG-208 otherwise). There is no upstream/downstream file pair: inverse views are queries, optionally materialized as generated .upstream.gen.* projections that are never hand-edited and never evidence sources.

edges.description: Outgoing (forward-direction) assertions, each referencing a CENTRAL contract in docs/registry/edge-contracts/ — contract definitions are never duplicated per node. A manifest citing a contract_id/version that does not match the central registry fails RWG-209.

payload.description: Optional; validated against the contract's payload_schema
